negative_control.description: Constant tokens must be caught by the distinctness assertion.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, make the session store issue the fixed string "a".repeat(43) instead of crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("base64url").

negative_control.description: A token that is returned but not recorded server-side must fail the readback.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, return the generated token from issue() without inserting it into the session Map.

negative_control.description: A session Map that grows without bound must be caught by size() reaching 10001.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, remove the eviction of the oldest-issued token from issue() so every token is kept.

negative_control.description: A distinguishable unknown-user body must fail the byte-equality assertion.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, respond to an unknown username with 401 {"error": "unknown user"} instead of the shared invalid-credentials body.

negative_control.description: Skipping password verification must be caught.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, replace the awaited users.verifyAsync(username, password) result with true for registered usernames.

negative_control.description: An off-by-one or missing lockout must be caught at the 6th attempt.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, change the lockout condition from failures >= 5 to failures > 5.

negative_control.description: A window that never expires must be caught.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, remove the step that drops failure timestamps once now() - ts >= 60000, so a locked username stays locked forever.

negative_control.description: A limiter keyed globally instead of per username must be caught.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, key the failure limiter on a constant string instead of the username.

negative_control.description: Limiting only registered usernames would leak which usernames exist and must be caught.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, record a failure only when users.has(username) is true.

negative_control.description: A success that resets the count must be caught by the final attempt returning 200 instead of 429.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, delete the username's failure record after a successful login.

negative_control.description: A fixed window that discards the whole record 60 seconds after the first failure lets a burst through at the boundary and must be caught by the last attempt returning 401 instead of 429.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, replace the per-failure timestamps with a single windowStart set at the first counted failure and a counter, and discard the whole record once now() - windowStart >= 60000.

negative_control.description: Verifying the password before the lock check, while still answering 429, must be caught by the verifyAsync and hashPasswordAsync counters rising on the locked attempts.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, move the password verification (users.verifyAsync for a registered username, hashPasswordAsync(password, DUMMY_SALT) for an unknown one) before the limiter check() and begin() calls, keep its result unused when the username is locked, and still return 429 for a locked username.

negative_control.description: A limiter Map that grows without bound must be caught by size() reaching 10001.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, remove the maxTracked check from recordFailure() so a new username is always added without pruning or evicting any record.

negative_control.description: A lock that counts only finished failures lets all 8 concurrent guesses be verified and must be caught by 8 calls and 8 401 responses.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, change the lock condition so check() and begin() test only the counted failure timestamps (timestamps >= 5) and ignore the pending count of attempts in verification.

negative_control.description: A limiter whose bound is enforced only in recordFailure() lets begin(), which creates the record for every new username on the POST /login path, grow the Map without limit, and must be caught by size() reaching 10001 with victim still locked.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, remove the maxTracked check from begin() so a new username is always added without pruning or evicting any record, leaving the check in recordFailure() unchanged.

negative_control.description: Logging the request body must be caught.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, add console.log(JSON.stringify(body)) after parsing the login request body.

negative_control.description: Logging the issued token must be caught.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, add console.info("issued session " + token) after issuing the token.

negative_control.description: Removing the username length check must be caught (the 65-character username would reach verify and return 401).
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, delete the username length > 64 validation.

negative_control.description: Removing the body cap must be caught.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, remove the MAX_BODY_BYTES check so the whole body is buffered and parsed.

negative_control.description: Counting 400 responses as failures must be caught.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, record a limiter failure for the username before returning a 400 response when the body is otherwise parseable.

negative_control.description: Breaking the existing route while wiring /login must be caught.
negative_control.mutation: In src/server.js, change the GET /health branch to respond via the 404 fallback (for example by matching url.pathname === "/healthz").

negative_control.description: Routing every method on /login to the handler must be caught.
negative_control.mutation: In src/server.js, route /login to the login handler regardless of req.method.

negative_control.description: Existence of test files is static evidence.
negative_control.exemption_reason: A static acceptance cannot have a runtime mutation; the runtime proofs of LOGIN-001 to LOGIN-005 and LOGIN-007 already fail if any of these files is missing.

negative_control.description: A queue without its 16-entry bound would park the 21st request instead of refusing it, and must be caught by the missing 503 within 2 seconds.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, remove the queued() < maxQueued test from createVerificationGate run() so a task is always queued when all slots are busy.

negative_control.description: Letting a 5th verification run concurrently must be caught by the maximum pending count of 5.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, change the createVerificationGate run() slot test from active() < maxActive to active() <= maxActive.

negative_control.description: Counting a 503 refusal as a failure must be caught by the final login returning 429.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, call limiter.recordFailure(username) before answering 503 when the gate is full.

negative_control.description: Running the unknown-user dummy hash outside the gate must be caught by gate.active() staying 0 and alice being answered before the dummy hashes settle.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, call hashPasswordAsync(password, DUMMY_SALT) for an unknown username directly instead of as a gate task, and run only users.verifyAsync through the gate.

negative_control.description: A slot that is freed only on resolve leaks on rejection and must be caught by the second batch never reaching verifyAsync.
negative_control.mutation: In src/login.js, move the slot release in createVerificationGate from a finally step into the task's resolve handler only, so a rejected task never decrements active.

negative_control.description: An asynchronous hash with different parameters must be caught by the Buffer comparison and the rejected correct password.
negative_control.mutation: In src/users.js, make hashPasswordAsync call crypto.scrypt with a key length of 64 instead of KEY_LENGTH.

suite.unit_command: node --test --test-timeout=20000 --test-force-exit test/login-success.test.js test/login-failure.test.js test/login-ratelimit.test.js test/login-validation.test.js test/login-logging.test.js test/login-concurrency.test.js

checks.name: Service smoke (boot and connectivity)
checks.reason: npm start binds a fixed port (PORT, default 3000) and runs until killed, so it cannot be a frozen exit-0 command; every runtime proof already boots the real http server from createServer on an ephemeral 127.0.0.1 port via test/helpers.js listen() and exercises it over HTTP with fetch.

checks.name: Lint
checks.reason: The repo configures no linter: package.json has only the start and test scripts and no dependencies, and there is no lint config file.

checks.name: Type check
checks.reason: The repo is plain CommonJS JavaScript with no TypeScript, JSDoc type checking or type checker configured.
